## How this work is cited

Passages inside Fasl al-maqal (The Decisive Treatise) are identified by section of the argument. A short legal-philosophical opinion on the relation between the Law and philosophy. It has no chapter divisions, so the archive cites a described section rather than a number.

## The work in Averroes’s thought

Ibn Rushd (Averroes, 1126–1198) served as qāḍī and physician in al-Andalus while producing the most influential Arabic commentaries on Aristotle. In the Decisive Treatise he argues that the Law itself obliges demonstrative reflection; in The Incoherence of the Incoherence he answers al-Ghazālī’s attack on the philosophers. [More on Averroes](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/averroes) .
